summary: Frontend-only verification of ORRBBIT subscription system (iter37). All 6 requested flows PASS on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Sarah signed in, /plans renders all 3 cards in correct order (Free/Plus/Pro) with prices $6.99 & $11.99 per month, radii 250m/500m/1km, badges Included/Most Popular/Best Reach, Current-plan tag on Free. Selecting Plus → CTA 'Upgrade to Plus'. Purchase-confirm modal renders with sandbox-label, recurring-billing text, Terms/Privacy/Refunds links, Subscribe button. Subscribe fired exact success alert 'Welcome to Orrbbit Plus. Your Radar now reaches up to 500 m.' /subscription then showed Orrbbit Plus card + TEST tag + 'Renews 9/5/2026' + Upgrade options + Restore Purchases + Manage Subscription. /account-data has 'ad-subscription' row that routes to /subscription. Radar radius sheet shows 100/250/500/750/1000 with 500=Plus lock + 750/1000=Pro lock for free user; tapping 500 opens paywall alert 'Unlock 500 m with Orrbbit Plus… Expand your orbit to discover more people and professionals nearby.', tapping Maybe later and re-tapping locked 500 does NOT re-show the paywall (session dismissal works). Fresh real user signup (fresh+<ts>@test.com / Password1! / DOB 1990-01-01) reaches /plans?next=setup; Plus card CTA is 'Coming Soon' and disabled (aria-disabled=true); selecting Free → 'Continue with Free' → advances to /profile-setup. CLEANUP: Sarah was reverted to Free via POST /api/billing/sandbox/expire (200 OK, plan=free confirmed).

ui_bugs.issue: On web, showAlert (src/lib/alert.ts) collapses multi-button alerts into a single window.confirm, so the Manage-subscription alert only exposes the first non-cancel button ('Cancel auto-renew') on OK. The 'End now (simulate expiry)' destructive option is unreachable from web UI — QA cleanup must call POST /api/billing/sandbox/expire directly. Native (iOS/Android) Alert.alert renders all 3 buttons correctly.

test_report_links: /app/tests/test_iter37_frontend.py (placeholder — actual flow executed inline via Playwright/mcp_browser_automation across 4 runs)
action_items: Consider extending src/lib/alert.ts to render a small custom modal on web when >2 buttons are supplied, so the sandbox 'End now (simulate expiry)' path can be reached from the web preview during QA (native is unaffected).
Everything else in the iter37 plans/subscription/radius paywall/signup Coming Soon flow is working as specified — no further action required.
critical_code_review_comments: plans.tsx correctly guards purchases with billing.sandbox_eligible (server re-verifies) — Coming Soon copy shown to real users; sandbox TEST label shown only when billing_mode=='sandbox'. Good.
RadiusSheet.tsx module-scoped `paywallDismissedThisSession` flag is process-lived (session-scoped as specified) — works because the module is not re-imported unless the app fully reloads.
showAlert web fallback is lossy for >2 buttons (see Manage flow issue above).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 requested flows verified; ~35 individual assertions passed across 3 Playwright runs)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 fresh real user (fresh+<timestamp>@test.com / Password1! / DOB 1990-01-01) during signup flow verification. Sarah's plan was temporarily elevated to Plus for the purchase flow, then reverted to Free (confirmed via GET /api/auth/me → plan=free).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sarah is on Free plan at end of this run. Fresh test accounts created with pattern fresh+<epoch>@test.com. On web, use POST /api/billing/sandbox/expire (with user's bearer token) for cleanup instead of the Manage-Subscription UI. The radar radius chip has testID 'radar-radius-chip' but its absolute-positioned element renders outside Playwright's viewport-click hitbox on 390x844 — use JS dispatch (evaluate + MouseEvent) to click it and the locked radius rows inside the modal.
rca_of_issue: Web-only limitation (not a product bug): src/lib/alert.ts:24-28 finds the first non-cancel button and uses it as OK for window.confirm, discarding the 2nd non-cancel button. The Manage sandbox subscription alert defines [Cancel auto-renew, End now (destructive), Close (cancel)] — on web OK fires 'Cancel auto-renew' and Cancel fires 'Close', leaving 'End now' unreachable. Fix: render a proper multi-button modal on web when buttons.length>=3.
